svg.title: Cross-block mask: paired task evidence
svg.desc: Mask off to mask on. Separate panels for GPU task results, original30 controls and CPU pilots.
svg.text: Every pair reads mask OFF → ON. ON blocks earlier queries from reading later blocks; compare only within each panel.
Historical GPU runs / original30: 10 per dataset / fixed windows, not hard caps; no trigger split
CPU pilot3 / first original30 case per dataset / full requests; first intervention is numbered from 1
CPU pilot3 / separate executor / replay_open (OFF) → replay (ON); subsets partition All three
CPU pilot3 / offers 4, 8, 16, 32, 64 / replay_open (OFF) → replay (ON); exposure subsets partition the same three cases
CPU pilot3 / fixed offer, not equal work / q512_open (OFF) → q512 (ON); subsets partition All three
F LLaDA 2.1-mini | Fixed Q64 admission × mask
CPU pilot3 / cases 0, 10, 20 / open (OFF) → causal (ON) within each policy; fixed offer, not equal work
G LLaDA 2.1-mini | Five-tier external replay, original 30
CPU BF16 / full requests; same three pilot cases are included, not independent / 10 per dataset
H DiffusionGemma | Fixed Q512, active-only W2
n164 GPU / 90 frozen requests; the original 30 and new 60 partition this cohort / same W2 admission
I DiffusionGemma | Unified five-tier external replay
n164 GPU / identical external offer sequence, task seeds and canvas RNG / all 90 retained
n164 GPU / same unified executor and frozen requests as panel I / fixed offer, not fixed total Q
K LLaDA 2.1-mini | Fixed Q64 admission and mask, original 30
CPU BF16 / same 30 requests in both rows / progress80 opens the next block after at least 80% one-step head progress
L LLaDA 2.1-mini | Fixed Q64, progress80 admission
n164 GPU0 / entire frozen cohort / paired fresh GPU runs, identical gate, open to causal
TPF = mean request N/F. Efficiency = total output tokens / total physical Q. No cross-panel average.
A: llada21-obs30-mask-paired.csv B: gemma-mask-cpu-pilot3.json C: gemma-unified-mask-pilot3.csv
D: llada21-all-slots-mask-pilot3.json E: gemma-unified-q512-mask-pilot3.csv F: llada21-q64-admission-mask-pilot3.json
